name: 4. Welcome (check-in day)
subject: Welcome to One Eleven
html:
Grab milk on your way, and tell us if anything isn’t right. ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏

WELCOME

Welcome, {{{GUEST_NAME}}}.

Today’s the day. Check-in is from 3pm, and your door code is {{{DOOR_CODE}}}.

PLEASE GRAB MILK ON YOUR WAY

With so many milk alternatives out there, it’s too hard for us to know what you like, so we don’t supply milk. We do have a barista coffee machine, with a bag of beans ready for you.

Please don’t wait until your review to tell us about your stay. If anything is missing or broken, or you need anything at all, reach out. We would much rather fix it than have you uncomfortable.

CALL OR TEXT 027 697 7961

Have an amazing time!

Matt & Ash

name: 5. Check-out morning
subject: See you again — check-out today
html:
Three small things before you head off. ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏

SAFE TRAVELS

Good morning, {{{GUEST_NAME}}}.

We hope you’ve had a wonderful stay. Check-out is by 10am, and your door code stops working shortly after.

We do the cleaning ourselves to save you a cleaning fee. Before you go, please help us turn the house around a little quicker:

1
Load and start the dishwasher.
2
Take your rubbish out to the wheelie bin down the side of the house.
3
Strip the beds if you can. It’s not expected, but it really helps.
 

If you strip the beds, please, please leave the mattress protectors and duvet inner protectors on. All bedding and towels go to the commercial laundry, so there’s no need to wash or dry anything.

Warm regards,

Matt & Ash

YOUR HOSTS
